acceptance: refused: no JBD2 checksum is verified (the algorithm is not derivable from the local primary header); candidate bytes are never authority and are never a recovered file

INFERRED (not stated in jbd2.h): a 16-byte UUID follows each tag whose flags lack SAME_UUID
the jbd2_journal_block_tail (4 bytes) occupies the last 4 bytes of descriptor and revoke blocks
each descriptor tag owns the next log block in order (wrapping from maxlen-1 to s_first); an ESCAPE image had its first 4 bytes (the magic) zeroed in the log
revoke records are be64 block numbers (64bit feature) from byte 16 up to r_count
the log area is [s_first, s_maxlen) with no fast-commit area (fast_commit unsupported here)
layoutBasis.NOT DERIVABLE LOCALLY: the JBD2 checksum algorithms (superblock, descriptor/revoke tail, tag, commit): no checksum is verified
layoutBasis.commit: jbd2.h struct commit_header: h_chksum_type @0x0C, h_chksum_size @0x0D, h_chksum[8] @0x10, be64 h_commit_sec @0x30, be32 h_commit_nsec @0x38
layoutBasis.header: jbd2.h journal_header_t: be32 h_magic, h_blocktype, h_sequence
layoutBasis.revoke: jbd2.h jbd2_journal_revoke_header_t: header + be32 r_count (bytes used)
layoutBasis.superblock: jbd2.h journal_superblock_t field offsets (0x0C blocksize, 0x10 maxlen, 0x14 first, 0x18 sequence, 0x1C start, 0x24/0x28/0x2C features, 0x30 uuid, 0x50 checksum_type, 0x54 num_fc_blks, 0x58 head, 0xFC checksum)
layoutBasis.tag: jbd2.h journal_block_tag3_t: be32 t_blocknr, t_flags, t_blocknr_high, t_checksum (16 bytes with csum_v3 + 64bit)
